entries.text: Orders from the Quartermaster, sealed and dry. Good work, runner.
This letter must reach the sergeant at the western outpost before nightfall. Follow the road west and hand it over yourself.
You have a letter for me? Let me see it.
Sealed Letter delivered
A Letter for the Outpost
She liked it? Then the smith is on his way. Good work.
The Quartermaster wants to see the ore before she sends her smith out here. Take her three Iron Ore, then come back and tell me what she said.
Has the Quartermaster seen the ore yet?
Iron Ore handed to the Quartermaster
Ore for the Quartermaster
Fine pelts, and sharp fangs. Choose something from my stores to keep you warm on the road.
The tanner pays well for good pelts, and the healer grinds wolf fangs into her salves. Bring me three Wolf Pelts and two Wolf Fangs.
Pelts and fangs, traveler. Have you brought them?
Wolf Fangs
Wolf Pelts
Pelts and Fangs
Iron for the gates and word to the town. The outpost owes you one.
The palisade needs iron for new hinges. Mine five Iron Ore in the quarry, then tell the Quartermaster in town that the iron is on its way.
Did you mine the iron and speak with the Quartermaster?
Iron Ore mined
Iron for the outpost? Tell the sergeant it is welcome, and that the road stays open.
Tell the Quartermaster
The Sergeant's Request
That is the alpha's fang, no doubt about it. The woods will be quieter now. Take your pick from the armory.
The pack follows an alpha, a scarred brute that lairs southwest of the woods. Kill it and bring me its fang as proof.
The alpha still lives. I can hear the pack at night.
Alpha's Fang
Feral Alpha slain
The Alpha
Five fewer wolves. The traders will sleep better tonight, and so will I. Take this for your trouble.
Feral wolves prowl the woods west of town, and the traders are scared to take the road. Thin the pack: bring down five of them.
The wolves still howl at night. Have you thinned the pack?
Feral Wolves slain
Wolves at the Gate
